children: RNS Number : 6350V  Sabre Insurance Group PLC  22 September 2026

Sabre Insurance Group plc (the "Group" or "Sabre"), one of the UK's leading motor insurance underwriters, is pleased to announce the appointment of Joh. Berenberg, Gossler & Co KG, London Branch ("Berenberg") as Joint Corporate Broker with immediate effect. Berenberg will work alongside our existing corporate brokers, Barclays and Panmure Liberum.
